patch.value: Tolerant action envelopes and corrective refusal feedback
Diagnose retained cloud response shapes, preserve action schema validation, reject ambiguity and test correction feedback.
Real-shape diagnosis; parser and feedback regressions with behavioral revert proofs

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Diagnosis before edits: the historical cloud harness deletes scratch ledgers in finally and publishes only response hashes. The 451 glm invalid-action outputs are unavailable, so their shapes cannot honestly be classified. A surviving older local-model ledger contains six exact responses {"action":"finish","answer":0}; these remain schema refusals. Historical question text conflicted with JSON protocol; merged main already makes questions format-neutral. Plan: wrapper extraction without key coercion, ambiguity refusal, specific correction feedback, recorded-shape regression plus synthetic wrapper edges; retain local-only new-run evidence.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implementation preserves string answer types and rejects duplicate keys, array envelopes, multiple objects and unterminated reasoning. Braces, escaped quotes and reasoning-like text inside JSON strings remain data. Both eval arms share envelope extraction for fair answer formatting. Initial focused suite passes 4/4. Full coverage initially found one untested absent-field branch; added a real-tracker boundary case. Shared eval helpers remove duplicate orchestration without lowering the zero-duplication threshold.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proofs: node test/v2-revert.ts passed 8/8. Parser envelope extraction, corrective feedback, count, sum, distinct, group_count, argmax and argmin each caused its targeted regression to fail with exit 1 when only that production behavior was removed; all source bytes restored. npx pm test pm-rlm-v2parse --run --progress passed both linked commands (focused tests 4/4 plus proofs 8/8). The tracker has result tracking disabled, so this comment is the durable result receipt. Full coverage passed 120/120 tests and 100/100/100/100 over 21 source files.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: New exact response retained in test/fixtures/glm-5.3-orphan-think.txt: prose, one count JSON example, an unmatched closing think tag, then a second identical count JSON object. It contains no workspace body or answer. The unchanged measured parser refuses this ambiguous envelope; with an explicit opening reasoning delimiter the same content parses. Added that recorded-shape regression without changing production behavior or tuning on answers.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Added an exact accepted cloud response fixture: test/fixtures/glm-5.3-prose-action.txt contains prose, a closing reasoning tag in the prefix, then one unique argmax object. Strict JSON.parse refuses it; the measured extractor delivers it without changing its operands. The new positive real-shape regression complements the ambiguous two-object refusal fixture. Production code and prompts remain unchanged; these are response-shape tests, not answer tuning.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final regression receipt: npx pm test pm-rlm-v2parse --run --progress --timeout 900 passed both linked commands: 6/6 focused tests and 10/10 behavioral revert proofs. Each invariant independently fails its regression when removed: parser extraction, fair stuffing extraction, corrective refusal feedback, historical seeded selection, count, sum, distinct, group_count, argmax and argmin. All modified source bytes were restored. Both exact accepted and refused cloud fixtures were verified against retained responses. Ten of thirteen delivered aggregates required envelope extraction.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final verification complete: 6/6 focused regressions, 10/10 independent behavioral revert proofs, and both full release checks at 122/122 plus 2/2 packed consumers each. Two exact new cloud fixtures distinguish a uniquely extractable action from ambiguous repeated objects. The historical cloud strings are unavailable; that evidence gap remains explicit. Claims are being released with items left in progress for orchestrator review.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Review round 1: merged main with normal merge drivers. Address parser-version compatibility for replay and resume, URL decoding in the live harness, and a shared validator/schema source for constrained Ollama and OpenAI-compatible output. Preserve the prior evaluation; one newly authorized constrained run uses the same frozen 24 tasks, without answer tuning. Review threads will not be replied to or resolved.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Compatibility design: missing parser_version means strict v1; explicit v2 preserves tolerant pre-schema parsing; new checkpoints use v3, whose discriminated union is also the runtime transport validator. Replay, cached responses, fresh resume responses and partition references select the recorded parser. Scope, child-refusal and slice semantic checks remain. Ollama receives format schema; OpenAI-compatible requests use strict json_schema with a generated object wrapper and required nullable optional fields, decoded to canonical actions. Stuffing receives its separate answer schema. Official Ollama docs currently say Cloud structured outputs are unsupported; the single authorized run will measure the requested wire behavior honestly, without retry or model substitution.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Revert proofs passed: node test/v2-revert.ts 10/10, including tolerant parser and each of count, sum, distinct, group_count, argmax and argmin. node test/constrained-revert.ts 6/6: checkpoint parser selection, strict v1 parsing, URL decoding, Ollama schema, OpenAI-compatible schema, shared validator. Each regression fails independently with only its behavior removed, then all source bytes are restored. Ajv independently verifies current schema/validator parity across all action alternatives and mutated operands. Initial full coverage attempt identified a missing declaration docstring and two legacy branches; addressed before freezing inference.
